evidence_quotes: Randvoorwaardenkorting wegens overschrijding gebruiksnormen Meststoffenwet door melkveehouderij.
overschrijding van de gebruiksnorm dierlijke meststoffen en de fosfaatgebruiksnorm in 2015.
rationale: This Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) decision concerns a cross-compliance subsidy reduction (randvoorwaardenkorting) imposed on a dairy farm for exceeding animal manure and phosphate application standards under the Dutch Fertilizers Act (Meststoffenwet) in 2015, along with limitation-period rules under Regulation 2988/95. Under the coding protocol, agricultural manure and phosphate quota/standard disputes under the Meststoffenwet are explicitly NOT_WATER and categorized as not_water_related.
